entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A technology that integrates structured knowledge graphs with natural language processing, applied in various domains like E-commerce and Biomedical.

entities.name: E-commerce

entities.name: Biomedical
entities.description: An application domain for GraphRAG focused on medical decision-making and question answering.

entities.name: Xu et al .

relationships.description: GraphRAG is applied in the E-commerce domain to improve shopping experiences and sales.
GraphRAG is applied in the Biomedical domain for question answering and decision-making.
Wang et al. proposed a specific GraphRAG technique involving ensembling multiple retrievers for subgraph extraction.
Xu et al. proposed a GraphRAG approach using a past-issue graph for customer service.
CMeKG is a knowledge graph belonging to the Biomedical domain.
CPubMed-KG is a knowledge graph belonging to the Biomedical domain.
The survey paper was published in J. ACM.
